card.name: Words just before a contact-or-report instruction
card.fires_on: Small words and commas at the end of an 'if X happens' clause, right before the instruction to contact, seek, stop or report. It also fires on 'should' or 'to' just before 'contact' or 'report'.

modes.label: Comma after condition
modes.description: A comma closing an 'if/when X occurs' clause, just before the action to take.
modes.example: any of the following adverse reactions occur<<,>> consider withholding until clinically stable or permanently discontin

modes.label: Helper word before contact
modes.description: 'should', 'to' or 'in' that leads into contacting, reporting or getting in touch.
modes.example: the caregiver<< should>> contact the child's doctor right away.

modes.label: Overdose contact line
modes.description: A comma after 'overdose' or 'overdosage' before the poison control referral.
modes.example: To obtain up-to-date information about the treatment of overdose<<,>> a good resource is the certified Regional Poison

card.writes: It seems to prepare words about contacting or reporting, and to lower the word 'report' itself (including Chinese forms).
card.plain: It marks the spot where a label turns from a problem to what to do, such as call the doctor.
